title: How Much Do Vets Really Make?
description:
Love animals? Guess what a vet earns. Not just puppy hugs.

Sources:
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Veterinarians 29-1131, annual median wage, May 2025: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029113113
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Veterinarians, 10th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029113111
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Veterinarians, 90th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029113115
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Veterinarians, employment: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029113101
- Wikipedia: Veterinary medicine in the United States: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Veterinary_medicine_in_the_United_States

Wikipedia (Veterinary medicine in the United States): as of 2021 there were only 33 accredited veterinary schools in the US; graduates must pass the North American Veterinary Licensing Exam, eight hours and 360 multiple-choice questions. BLS May 2025 (OEWS), veterinarians (29-1131): 83,900 jobs; median $130,100; 10th percentile $73,920; 90th percentile $215,700. Median = half earn more, half earn less. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Love animals? Guess what a vet earns. Not just puppy hugs.
First, get in. The US had just 33 vet schools in 2021.
Then pass one exam. Eight hours. 360 questions.
The payoff? A median of 130,100 dollars a year.
The top ten percent? Even more. Not bad for petting puppies.
